title: MathformerPhysicsLib foundations workflow
summary: Autoformalize fundamental physics concepts and mathematical objects through Mathlib-first foundation intake, surface design, drafting, and verification.

visible_workflows.description: Given physics concepts or object packets, produce MathformerPhysicsLib foundation surfaces grounded in existing Mathlib objects whenever possible.
evidence_gates: python scripts/mathformer.py ask "run MathformerPhysicsLib foundations workflow" --run --json

composed_skills.role: Normalize fundamental objects into explicit foundation packets.
Design Mathlib-grounded Lean surfaces before drafting local support.
Draft controlled foundation modules from accepted surface plans.
Check promotion readiness and structural evidence for drafted modules.
Route detected physics objects through MathformerPhysicsLib-first workbench planning.

generated_skills.promotion_boundary: Generated foundation modules may support MathformerPhysicsLib after verification, but do not become general skills without lifecycle evidence.

release_boundaries.rule: Existing Mathlib declarations must be checked before adding local foundation support.
A foundation surface is not promoted from one successful controlled suite run alone.

risk_controls.control: Surface design records Mathlib grounding and blockers before drafting.
Verification report and generated skill lifecycle must pass before promotion.
